assertions.fallback: AI failure falls back to the rule colour countdown; no token keeps the legacy pending timeout; a red item never auto-resolves
assertions.proof: gpw-ai 9/9, gpw-ai-priority 3/3, existing GPW suites green, client-bundle 36/36, loader-entry 10/10 in real Chromium, claims green, eslint 0 errors
